banner.label: Cookie notice
banner.title: Cookies
banner.text: We use the cookies needed to run the site. If you wish, you can also allow analytics that helps us understand how the site is used.

dialog.title: Cookie preferences
dialog.text: Choose which cookies to allow. You can change your choice at any time.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.text: Remember your language, appearance, currency and session. The site does not work without them; they are always on.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: Helps us measure which pages are used without keeping personal data. When off, no analytics is loaded.
